name: Studio Creatio
description_en:
Studio Creatio is a product in the Application development category. Its directory profile covers Marketing Management, Employee Management, Order Management, Scheduling, Performance Metrics, Financial Management, CRM, Project Management.

Additional listed capabilities include Purchasing, Billing and Invoicing. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $25.00.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: maintain employee records and related workflows; track orders and their progress through fulfillment; allocate times for appointments, resources or tasks; coordinate project tasks, responsibilities and progress; prepare invoices and track billing records. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Studio Creatio 属于应用开发软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括营销管理、员工管理、订单管理、排程管理、绩效指标、财务管理、客户关系管理、项目管理。

资料还列出采购、账单与开票。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 起价为 $25.00.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：维护员工记录和相关工作流程；跟踪订单及履约进展；为预约、资源或任务安排时间；协调项目任务、负责人和进度；制作发票并跟踪账单记录。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
